question: Who is able to set low pond-water in motion?
premises: The shaped form is set by someone.
Low pond-water needs an agent to move.
Supreme lord is named as that agent.
inference: The verse asks who besides the supreme lord can initiate this descent.
uncertainties: Exact root parsing of nyarūpyata is not fully certain.
plain_english: Just as this was shaped by some supreme lord, who is able to set low pond-water in motion?
